answer.reason: The verses tell of the pillar's setting up in the temple porch and, in the context, its breaking and carrying off to Babylon.

clauses.english: was set up in the porch of the temple and named Boaz
clauses.quote: he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by the Chaldees, and its brass carried to Babylon
clauses.quote: did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon

doubts: The Boaz pillar is not named in the destruction verses; it is covered there as one of the two pillars of brass in the house of the LORD.
2CH 3:15 gives a different height (thirty and five cubits) than 1KI 7:15; left out.
